newsitem.title: IRAN: Khatami should select martyrs for cabinet - paper.
newsitem.headline: Khatami should select martyrs for cabinet - paper.

text.p: A hardline Iranian newspaper on Tuesday suggested that President-elect Mohammad Khatami's first cabinet should include martyrs who died for the Islamic cause.

The bi-weekly Shalamcheh, representing the militant group Ansar Hezbollah (Supporters of the Party of God), said the new cabinet should entirely comprise martyrs or those who were killed defending the Islamic republic.
Army commanders who fell in the 1980-1988 war with Iraq should be the majority in Khatami's cabinet, it said.
"We believe that our proposed ministers have the right to take control not only of the ministries, but all the key positions of the state," Shalamcheh said.
Khatami, a moderate Shi'ite Moslem clergyman elected by a landslide in May, is due to succeed President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Sunday.
All cabinet nominations have to be approved by parliament and the Guardian Council of senior clerics and lawyers, which has the final say.
